paraphrase: The wise declare that the worship (upāsti) of Him is the path to heaven and liberation; this Supreme Self is examined here.
speaker: Udayana
notes: Verse numbering of the Nyāyakusumāñjali varies by edition; the number is from memory.

paraphrase: This discussion by reasoning about the Lord, which bears the name of reflection (manana), is itself worship (upāsanā), coming after hearing (śravaṇa).
speaker: Udayana
notes: Verse numbering of the Nyāyakusumāñjali varies by edition; the number is from memory.

paraphrase: There is a supersensible cause (of experience), since (results) depend (on causes), (the series) is beginningless, (results) are various, (this) holds universally, is restricted to each self, and is experienced.
speaker: Udayana
notes: Verse 'sāpekṣatvād anāditvād...' recalled from memory; number not known.

paraphrase: The Lord's existence is questioned for five reasons, answered in the five clusters: that there is no supersensible means to the other world; that such means can be performed even without Him; that there are proofs of His non-existence; that even if He exists He is not an authority; and that there is no proof establishing Him.
speaker: Udayana
notes: Verse numbering of the Nyāyakusumāñjali varies by edition; the number is from memory.

paraphrase: Whatever human aim they seek, all worship Him: the Upaniṣadic thinkers as the pure, awakened by nature; the Kāpilas (Sāṃkhya) as the first knower, the perfected one; the Pātañjalas as untouched by afflictions, karma, its fruition and residues, who assumes a created body to reveal the tradition and shows grace; the Mahāpāśupatas as undefiled and independent; the Śaivas as Śiva; the Vaiṣṇavas as Puruṣottama; the Paurāṇikas as the Grandfather; the ritualists as the Person of the sacrifice; the Saugatas as the omniscient; the Digambaras as the unobstructed; the Mīmāṃsakas as what is taught as the object of worship; the Cārvākas as what is established by worldly usage; the Naiyāyikas as one endowed with whatever (qualities) are shown to fit; even artisans worship Him as Viśvakarman.
speaker: Udayana
notes: Content recalled with moderate confidence; exact wording, order of the list and position in the text (prose before or after the opening verses) not checked.

paraphrase: When two (alternatives) are contradictories, there is no third possibility; nor can the contradictories be one, since saying so is itself contradictory.
speaker: Udayana
notes: Quoted as Udayana's (kusumāñjalau) in the modern commentary of the local Bhāṣāpariccheda e-text, where it is used to show that no further categories are possible; the verse number 3.8 is from memory.

paraphrase: In Gautama's view, valid cognition is correct determination; being a valid knower is possessing it; and the Lord's authority is the exclusion of His ever lacking it.
speaker: Udayana
notes: Verse numbering of the Nyāyakusumāñjali varies by edition; the number is from memory.

paraphrase: The all-knowing, imperishable (maker) is to be proved from: effects (the world being an effect), the combining (of atoms at creation), support (of the world) and the rest (e.g. destruction), traditional skills (and usage of words), the validity (of the Veda), scripture, (the Veda's being made of) sentences, and a special number (the magnitude of dyads, which needs an enumerating cognition at creation).

original.text: kāryāyojanadhṛtyādeḥ padāt pratyayataḥ śruteḥ / vākyāt saṃkhyāviśeṣāc ca sādhyo viśvavid avyayaḥ
original.edition: from memory; the opening words are quoted as the Ācārya's verse in the local Subodhinī e-text

speaker: Udayana
notes: The glosses in parentheses follow the usual explanation of the verse's cryptic terms; the verse number (first of the fifth cluster) is the usual citation.

paraphrase: Those in whose hearts, though washed by abundant floods of scripture and reasoning, the Lord finds no place are stone-hearted; yet even those who oppose Him think of Him intensely, and in time, O compassionate one, they too are to be saved by Your grace.
speaker: Udayana
notes: Content recalled; wording and position not checked.
